fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: all five do. 1 — showing someone else's data. 2 — real data in an environment with weaker controls. 3 — transferring to a third party without a basis. 4 — personal data and possibly secrets in logs. 5 — direct access to someone else's data via enumeration. Takeaway: three out of five are product decisions, not engineering bugs.
